standard.summary: 细粒度 LoRA rank 策略：对不同层分配不同的 rank，而非全局使用同一 rank，可在相同参数预算下提升学习效率。
standard.effect: coupled-prune = 根据层重要性自动剪枝分配 rank（重要层高 rank，次要层低 rank）；orthogonal-redistribute = 正交重分配（保持总参数量，优化各层 rank 分布）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。想在固定参数预算下最大化学习效率时尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 不了解各层重要性时保持默认（全局统一 rank），不确定性更小。

optionDescriptions.fim_profile: 按 FIM/重要性表分 rank。

standard_en.summary: Fine-grained LoRA rank policy: gives different layers different ranks instead of one rank everywhere, raising learning efficiency at the same parameter budget.
standard_en.effect: coupled-prune allocates rank by pruning on layer importance (high rank for important layers, low for secondary ones); orthogonal-redistribute redistributes orthogonally, keeping the total parameter count while optimising the per-layer rank distribution.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying when you want the most learning out of a fixed parameter budget.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep the default (one uniform rank) when you do not know the relative importance of the layers -- it carries less uncertainty.

optionDescriptions.coupled_prune: Cuts or lowers weak layers and adds rank to strong ones.
optionDescriptions.orthogonal_redistribute: Keeps every layer and only redistributes rank.
optionDescriptions.fim_profile: Allocates rank from the FIM / importance table.

advanced.principle: 通过分析各层梯度 stable rank 或权重奇异值分布，动态调整各层的 LoRA rank 分配。fg_lora_rank_map_json 允许手动指定每层的 rank，提供最大灵活性。
advanced.tradeoffs: 非均匀 rank 分配使 LoRA 结构更复杂，与某些推理框架（如 A1111）的标准 LoRA 加载可能不完全兼容。

advanced_en.principle: Dynamically adjusts per-layer LoRA rank allocation by analyzing each layer's gradient stable rank or weight singular-value distribution. fg_lora_rank_map_json allows manually specifying per-layer rank for maximum flexibility.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Non-uniform rank allocation makes the LoRA structure more complex and may not fully load as a standard LoRA in some inference frameworks (e.g. A1111).
